units: <cite ref="Shabbat 86a:5">Sabb. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>בה׳ עלה</he> he went up early in the morning. Sifra K’dosh. ch. III, Par. 2 <he>צא בה׳</he> start early.—
Sabb. 127ᵃ הַשְׁכָּמַת בה״מ coming in good time to college; a. fr.—Trnsf. eagerness.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:6">Y. Shek. I, 45ᵈ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="E00918"><he>הַשְׁחָתָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: going to labor in the morning. Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11ᵇ שתהא השלמה (corr. acc.), v. הַעֲרָבָה.
